paragraphs.text: The Ironclaw Mountains is a relatively mineral-rich mountain range that forms the northeastern edge of central South Aerona on Dominaria . The range, also referred to as Ironclaw , is home to the Ironclaw orcs , goblins and scattered dwarven clans. To the west, they are connected to the Hurloon Mountains and the Red Iron Mountains .

In a distant future, the Ironclaw Mountains will have been leveled by Benalia and the merfolk in a terrible war against the orcs. The remaining portions of the mountain range became the Ironclaw Hills , a trading port inhabited by orcs, goblins, kobolds , centaurs , dwarves, and some merfolk . The region maintained trading routes over the Razdali Ocean (probably a new name for the Voda Sea ). In this period, Ironclaw is a seaport which hosts a merfolk Seafarers' Guild and a Merchants' Guild. One of the docks is called Pundin Quay.
